description: Regression values of this repository (not literature values): structural-sensitivity (wavemaker) field of the Re=1914 cubic cavity from the leading direct and adjoint modes of the gate runs of 310 and 320, on the base flow of 210/fp. The peak position is not checked: the field has two maxima that differ by 0.4 %, at (-0.365, -0.244, 0) and (-0.307, 0.333, 0).

wavemaker_max.note: Largest value of the wavemaker field, which the run stores in the temperature slot.
